not_claimed: Measured runtime improvement or universal practical speedup

required_hypotheses: Certified common inverse spectral gap bound for the actual fixed finite lazy reversible bin kernels

numeric_convention: Schedule values and ratios are exact strings. Only fields explicitly named approx_display_only use floating point.

work_accounting.bin_transitions: Exact ideal-kernel transition calls, including each independent block's burn-in
work_accounting.correction_evaluations: One source correction arithmetic evaluation per recorded correction-bin observation
work_accounting.limitations: These are separate operation allowances, not equally priced machine steps. Operand sizes, evaluation internals, array moves, and final product work must be included for a complete machine-cost comparison. No timings were collected.
work_accounting.mean_divisions: One division by the deterministic observation count per block mean
work_accounting.median_comparison_bound: At most M(M-1)/2 rational comparisons per factor using explicit insertion
work_accounting.ratio_evaluations: One exact ratio evaluation per recorded ratio-bin observation
work_accounting.scalar_offset_draws: Uniform upper allowance d per correction evaluation, coupled to exact conditional offsets
